lines.en: I jog the village road with my rifle up.

lines.zh: 靴底拍在地上，节奏很快
lines.en: My boot soles slap the ground in quick time.
I hug the wall to show less of myself.
The Red Ribbon uniform is a bit big on me.

lines.zh: 我边走边看两边的窗口
lines.en: I watch the windows on both sides as I go.

lines.zh: 帽檐压得很低，遮住眼睛
lines.en: My cap brim sits low over my eyes.
Field mud sticks to my boots.
I walk in the cart ruts to save effort.
I glance back down the road I came.

lines.zh: 小跑一段，我就停一下听
lines.en: I jog a stretch, then stop and listen.
I shift the rifle to my other hand.
Grass blades rake my trouser leg.
I lean on the fence, catching my breath.

lines.zh: 制服口袋里还有半块干粮
lines.en: Half a ration left in my uniform pocket.
I tighten the rifle strap.

lines.zh: 村口有两条路，我记住方向
lines.en: Two roads at the gate. I've marked them.
Dust on my cap; I brush it off.
I listen to the chickens in the village.
A blister on my foot. I ignore it.
I roll my sleeve to the elbow.

lines.zh: 上头说要巡查，我就巡查
lines.en: Orders say patrol. So I patrol.
Not a hard job, just tiring.
I count the rounds in my rifle.
The wind tips my cap crooked.
I crouch to tie a lace.
A cow lows in the distance.

lines.zh: 我把水壶摇了摇，还剩一点
lines.en: I shake my canteen. A little left.
The sun burns the back of my neck.
I switch the rifle to the other shoulder.
No one's come to relieve me.
Halt. This road is closed.
I raise a hand for you to stop.
I haven't seen your face before.
Lower your weapon. Slowly.
My footing is better than yours. Don't try.
Red Ribbon is clearing this area.
Anyone behind you?
I count to five, and you leave.
My finger rests by the trigger.
You don't look like a villager.
Don't smile. That won't work on me.
Fine. Then we do it by the rules.
I grunt and fold at the waist.
My uniform has a fresh tear.
Blood sticks my sleeve to my arm.
I give half a step, rifle still up.
That one was heavy. I'll admit it.
I grit my teeth and change stance.
A corner of my cap brim is gone.
The pain sharpens me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸乱了，但手没抖
lines.en: My breathing's ragged; my hands aren't.
Again. I'm not down.
Put it on the ground and back three steps.

lines.zh: 干粮早吃完了，这东西真香。
lines.en: My rations ran out days ago; that smells good.

lines.zh: 别举着走过来，我会开枪
lines.en: Don't walk over holding it up.
Leave it there; I'll take it myself.
Is this meant to buy me off?
The captain would chew me out.
I look at it for two seconds.
You've got sense, but not enough.
I edge half a step aside.
Leave the food. You go.
You knock me and the rifle nearly slips.
I turn to shed it, heels scraping.
Back off. Don't touch my rifle.
You knocked my shoulder strap crooked.
I'll count that against you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，帽子掉了
lines.en: We collide and my cap falls.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡帽子，眼睛没离你
lines.en: I pick up my cap without looking away.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜没用在正处
lines.en: Strong enough, wrong place to use it.

lines.zh: 我又站稳了，你最好别再来
lines.en: I'm set again. Don't try twice.
Two paces from me. That's discipline.
A soldier like me isn't worth much.

lines.zh: 你要是留下，就跟我站一班
lines.en: If you stay, take a watch with me.
I'll split my ration with you.
Wind's strong at night. Sleep by the wall.
I'll point my rifle outward.

lines.zh: 上尉问起来，我说你是我表亲
lines.en: If the captain asks, you're my cousin.
I'm not good at saying this.
But I don't want to stand watch alone.
Take my cap. It'll shade you.
Tomorrow we move to another village.

lines.zh: 红石揣进兜里，交差够数。
lines.en: Redstone into my pocket — enough to report.
This could fetch a bit of coin.
Redstone? Good for the report.
Small iron nuggets still count.
You dropped it. It's mine now.
I stuff it into my uniform pocket.
Too heavy. I'll take half.
I weigh it in my hand. Some heft.
Keep what's useful, drop the rest.
When I'm done I look up at you.
You moved. I'll call that hostile.
Rifle up. Don't move.

lines.zh: 红缎带的规矩：先喊后打
lines.en: Red Ribbon rules: shout first, shoot after.
You didn't listen, so don't blame me.
I drop low.

lines.zh: 枪口压在你胸口的高度。
lines.en: The barrel settles at chest height.
My muzzle follows you.

lines.zh: 你选错了要打交道的人
lines.en: You picked the wrong person to cross.
Calling for help won't do any good.
Engaging. Three rounds, rapid.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂压上去，一步。
lines.en: I press up along the field ridge, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 你往树后躲，我就换个角
lines.en: You duck behind a tree; I change angle.
I'm cutting off your retreat.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很响，我听得见
lines.en: Your breathing is loud. I hear it.
Don't run. Running makes you a target.

lines.zh: 我等你从篱笆后面出来
lines.en: I wait for you to come out from the fence.
My muzzle holds steady.
I have all the patience. Do you?
I scouted this road earlier.
Five steps closer and I fire.
The rifle butt swings at your wrist.
I kick at the back of your knee.
Close in, I draw the short blade.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你护甲边上
lines.en: This one lands on your armour's edge.
I put my whole weight behind it.
You fall back; I take a step.
My moves aren't pretty, just fast.
The shove drops you onto the ground.
This cut opens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 打完我立刻退开，重新举枪
lines.en: I disengage and raise the rifle again.

lines.zh: 我在村口站定，先整帽檐
lines.en: I stop at the gate and straighten my cap.
The Red Ribbon squad has arrived.

lines.zh: 靴底还带着上一片地的泥
lines.en: My boots still carry mud from the last place.
The order is to patrol.
I load rounds into the rifle.

lines.zh: 这片村子看着还算安静
lines.en: This village looks quiet enough.

lines.zh: 我不是本地人，一眼看得出
lines.en: I'm clearly not from here.
New uniform, old soldier.

lines.zh: 我从草原那边一路走过来
lines.en: I walked here from the savanna.

lines.zh: 先看看这村有几个出口
lines.en: First, how many ways out of this village.
Good sun, good visibility.
Starting today's patrol.

lines.zh: 袖子着火，我在地上滚了一圈
lines.en: My sleeve burns; I roll on the ground.

lines.zh: 落地时脚踝一扭，疼得冒汗
lines.en: I land badly and twist my ankle.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命往上蹬
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I kick desperately up.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: The blast flips me over; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的腿，我跪下来
lines.en: An arrow through my leg drops me to a knee.

lines.zh: 这光烫得我看不清东西
lines.en: That light burns and I can barely see.
Hunger shakes my hands off the rifle.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我旁边，我整个人麻了
lines.en: Lightning hits beside me and I go numb.

lines.zh: 什么都没了，我一直在掉
lines.en: Nothing left around me and I keep falling.
